verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms docs.simular.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to per-page markdown. A second llms.txt at www.simular.ai describes the REST API endpoints, the SDK and MCP server, workflow templates, and how legacy product pages relate to Sai, so the docs are clearly agent-oriented. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and no full-content llms-full.txt is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://docs.simular.ai/llms.txt # Simular Developer Documentation
`GET /v1/agents/events` streams progress; `POST /v1/agents/approve` answers an approval request; `GET /v1/agents/machines` lists your computers.
gives developers, their code and their coding agents the same autonomous computer through a REST API, a Python SDK and an MCP server.
Pages about Simular Pro, Simular Desktop, Simular Cloud and Simular 1.0 describe earlier products that are now part of Sai.
